fixtures.description: Chemical supplier email with multi-lingual disclaimer and critical chemical blend numbers
fixtures.raw_text:
Dear Team,

Regarding the AZ SR-210 batch M18 photospeed shift, our QA team has confirmed that the PAC blend ratio was adjusted from 60.4:39.6 to 59.5:40.5. This resulted in an Eth shift from 23.5mJ to 25.0mJ.
Please adjust exposure dose by +1.2mJ on Track PHT02 to compensate.

Best Regards,
Technical Service Specialist
Merck Electronic Materials Ltd.
